Revaluation of land and buildings
The revaluation reserve in equity relates to the value of the Stanbic office in Chiromo at the point of merger
between CFC Bank and Stanbic Bank in 2008. The fair value of the properties was determined using the market
comparable method. This means that valuations performed by the valuer were based on active market prices,
significantly adjusted for differences in the nature, location or condition of the specific property.
